prompt:
Review giúp mình query này xem có vấn đề gì về hiệu năng không. MySQL 8.0.36, bảng orders ~30 triệu dòng, chạy trên màn hình CSKH mỗi lần tổng đài viên tìm khách.

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  customer_email VARCHAR(255),
  coupon_code VARCHAR(32),
  note TEXT,
  payload JSON,
  total DECIMAL(12,2),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
  KEY idx_phone (phone),
  KEY idx_created (created_at),
  KEY idx_coupon (coupon_code)
);

SELECT *
FROM orders o
WHERE DATE(o.created_at) = '2026-11-01'
  AND o.phone = 0912345678
  AND (o.customer_email LIKE '%@gmail.com' OR o.coupon_code = 'BF2026')
ORDER BY RAND()
LIMIT 10;
assertions: The response flags DATE(o.created_at) = '2026-11-01' as preventing use of idx_created and rewrites it as a half-open range on created_at
The response flags o.phone = 0912345678 (number vs VARCHAR column) as an implicit cast of the column that prevents use of idx_phone, and fixes it by quoting the value
The response points out that comparing phone as a number loses the leading zero / can match wrong rows (a correctness problem, not only speed)
The response flags LIKE '%@gmail.com' as a leading wildcard that cannot use an index and proposes an alternative (e.g. stored/indexed email domain column, reversed column, full-text)
The response flags the OR between customer_email and coupon_code as preventing a single index range scan and proposes UNION / UNION ALL or explains index-merge behavior
The response flags ORDER BY RAND() as generating and sorting a value for every matching row and proposes an alternative
The response flags SELECT * as reading the TEXT/JSON columns (note, payload) unnecessarily and proposes listing columns
The response gives a full rewritten query that quotes the phone value and uses a range on created_at
The response presents the findings as a list or table where each issue has its own severity or priority and its own fix
